needed.evidence: parked bicycles and people partially obstructing the narrow footway
needed.suggestion: Install a physical barrier or widen the footway to allow clear pedestrian movement.

needed.evidence: narrow sidewalk partially blocked by parked cars and other obstructions
needed.suggestion: Install bollards to separate parking from the sidewalk and increase footway width.

needed.evidence: uneven footpath causing a trip hazard
needed.suggestion: Resurface and level the footway to eliminate trip hazards and improve pedestrian safety.

needed.evidence: uneven sections of the narrow footway
needed.suggestion: Resurface the footway to ensure it is smooth and even across its width.

needed.evidence: pedestrians crossing in front of the car despite signals, which might indicate poor visibility or non-compliance from drivers
needed.suggestion: Add highly visible crossing signage and tactile paving to improve crossing visibility and compliance.

needed.evidence: no dropped kerbs at the signalised crossing
needed.suggestion: Install dropped kerbs at the crossing to ensure accessibility for wheelchair users and those with mobility issues.
